PB18-U06.name: Glitter Tiga
PB18-U06.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Blue & Cost 6 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

This card/Spirit is also treated as being exactly-named "Ultraman".

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with the highest cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When the opponent would use card from their Hand, unless they send two cores from their Reserve to the Trash, they can't use it. While this Spirit is [During Advent], this effect sends +2 cores to Trash.

PB18-U07.name: Nebula M78
PB18-U07.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your "Ultraman"-named Spirits would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by exhausting this Nexus, all of them remain on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2] (When Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Summon any number of "Ultraman"-named Spirit cards among them, paying one cost for each. Discard any remaining cards.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14086.name: Ultraman Blu Aqua
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14086.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 5 ([Blue Core][Blue Core][Blue Core])]
Destroy an opposing Cost 7 or more Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace one of your Cost 7 or less "Ultraman" Spirits with this card in refreshed condition.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Declare either Spirit card or Magic card. During this turn, the opponent can't activate Burst effects of the declared card type.

PB18-U04.name: Ultraman Dyna
PB18-U04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Cost 2/4/6 Spirit. When this effect destroys, put two cores from the Void to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
All your "Ultraman"-named Spirits gain +5000 BP and +2 Cost.

PB18-U01.name: Ultraman Gaia (V2)
PB18-U01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Draw a card, then discard a card from your Hand. When this effect discards any "Ultraman", destroy an opposing Cost 4 or less Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
When you're summoning an "Ultraman" Spirit card, this Spirit gains two extra Blue symbols.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14109.name: Ultraman Rosso Flame
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A14109.effect:
Flash - [Change: Cost 4 ([Blue Core][Blue Core])]
Destroy an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit/Ultimate. Also, if you control any "Blu" Spirit, destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit/Ultimate. After this effect resolves, either discard this card or replace one of your Cost 7 or less "Ultraman" Spirits with this card in refreshed condition.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit.

PB18-U05.name: Ultraman Tarou
PB18-U05.effect:
During (Either End Step), by sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, return this card from your Trash to the Hand.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy an opposing Cost 8 or less Spirit/Ultimate. When this effect destroys, draw a card. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By destroying this Spirit, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of Cost 8.
